scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && npm run build:web && wrangler dev
scripts.dev:prepare: node scripts/prepare-local-dev.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrations:apply && wrangler deploy
scripts.format:check: npx --yes prettier@3.9.6 --check package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json README.md ../README.md ../documentation ../iOS/README.md ../.github/workflows scripts src test web/index.html web/src web/tsconfig.json web/vite.config.ts
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run validate:worker

DB.description: Instance-local D1 database for Downwrite metadata, sessions, passkey challenges, groups, documents, collaborators, public share links, and coarse abuse throttles.

CONTENT.description: Instance-local R2 bucket for Markdown document bodies owned by the deployer's Cloudflare account.

DEVELOPMENT_API_TOKENS.description: Comma-separated local identity token map in `identity:token` form. Example: `dev-owner:replace-with-random-token,dev-editor:another-random-token`. This is an instance-local development adapter, not a central Downwrite login service.

DOWNWRITE_LOCAL_AUTH.description: Set to `1` only in local `.dev.vars` to enable localhost-only browser development sign-in. Do not configure this for production deployments.

AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Instance-local one-time owner setup secret. Configure as a Worker secret; do not commit a production value.

DOWNWRITE_REGISTRATION_MODE.description: Operator-controlled production registration mode. Defaults to `closed`; set to `open` for public registration or `email_domain` to restrict new passkey registration to configured email domains.

DOWNWRITE_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated allowed email domains used only when DOWNWRITE_REGISTRATION_MODE=email_domain. Example: `example.com,team.example.com`.

WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME.description: Display name shown by passkey authenticators for this self-hosted instance.

WEBAUTHN_RP_ID.description: Optional WebAuthn relying-party ID, usually the production custom-domain host.

INSTANCE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional canonical public base URL used in discovery and passkey origin checks.
